rows.abstract: Defines the term “Data” to encompass any information, including but not limited to personal data, non-personal data, statistical data, research findings, reports, and any other data collected, generated, or processed in the course of fulfilling a contract with the government. Address the importance of data collected by contractors through the implementation of programs and projects, in partnership with the government, and establish government ownership over such data collected. rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE OPERATION OF MOTORCYCLES-FOR-HIRE AND PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATION THEREOF
rows.title_short: Motorcycles - For - Hire Act
rows.abstract:
Intends to establish mechanisms and guidelines in regulating all the operational aspects of motorcycle-for-hire and to ensure the safety of the riding public.
Requires all motorcycles intended to be used as a motorcycle-for-hire to be duly registered with the Land Transportation Office (LTO) which shall ensure the roadworthiness of all motorcycle-for-hire before their registration or renewal.
Requires the operators of motorcycles-for-hire to have insurance coverage for the driver, rider, and third party.
Mandates the Department of Transportation (DOTr) to prescribe the standards and specifications of motorcycles that may be allowed to operate as motorcycles-for-hire for the safety of the passengers and riders and the protection of goods.
Grants the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) the authority to issue franchises of motorcycles-for-hire in areas with existing and operating digital platforms.
Allows the motorcycles-for-hire to operate using the digital platforms; or on designated areas of operation.

rows.title_full: AN ACT ADJUSTING THE MONTHLY PENSION BENEFITS OF RETIREES OF THE DEPARTMENT OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS
rows.title_short: Foreign Affairs Retirement Benefits Act
rows.abstract:
Seeks to increase the monthly pension of retirees of the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) to be at par with the current pay scale enjoyed by those in active service.
Applies to retired DFA officers and employees who receive a monthly pension from the GSIS and those who opted to retire under RA 1616 and have fully met the following qualifications: 1.) reached 65 years of age; 2.) served in the DFA for at least 15 years; and 3.) are Filipino citizens.
Adjusts the monthly pension benefits of all retirees of the DFA to the existing rate, and any subsequent increase thereof, of the salary grade of the rank they held upon retirement.
Provides conditions on the survivorship benefits in case a DFA retiree or personnel dies.

rows.abstract:
Seeks to amend the family code whereby a marriage may be annulled for any of the following causes, existing at the time of marriage OR APPEARED AFTER THE MARRIAGE:Â  either party - was of unsound mind . . . ; Â was physically incapable of consummating the marriage with the other . . . ;Â  was afflicted with a sexually-transmissible disease . . .
Proposes additional grounds for annulment of marriage related to the following:Â  psychological incapacity; homosexuality/lesbianism and sex reassignment surgery or transition; serious physical violence or grossly abusive conduct; moral pressure to change religious or political affiliation; to induce to engage in prostitution and gambling; final judgment sentencing to imprisonment. . . ; drug addiction, habitual alcoholism or chronic gambling; contracting a subsequent bigamous marriage; marital infidelity or perversion or having a child with another person . . . attempt against life; or abandonment without justifiable cause . . ., etc.
Provides that the FAMILY COURT shall assist the INDIGENT AND UNDERPRIVILEGED PETITIONER FOR THE FREE LEGAL SERVICES OF THE PUBLIC ATTORNEY´S OFFICE.
Proposes to amend existing grounds and adopt other grounds for a petition for legal separation, some of which are similar to causes for annulment.
